patch_section_boundary_rule: First original exterior section rail below4.2mm and first above7.8mm, mirrored by actual X only. The source rails determine actual bounds.
base_reference: Actual piecewise-linear source triangle containing each structured parameter point, never an unconstrained quad interpolation.
new_target: Same unchanged existing groove fields/p4union in the same source U/t coordinates. C1weight fades toward actual source-triangle surface at patch boundary; no new family/pitch.
protected: All original non-overlap vertex coordinates, X coordinates and six bounds; old faces outside patch plus necessary boundary-edge splits retain their actual planar geometry.
normal_rule: Actual fresh mesh smooth normals inside patch, C1fade to retained source corner-normal inputs at boundary. Quantization measured, no post-export repair.
visual_requirement: No pinched bulges or stepped lips in native same-camera gray before reflection/material/96.
